stories.title: Police warning after elderly victims told to withdraw cash and post it to London
stories.summary: North Wales Police is warning people to be alert to scam phone calls, after two elderly victims were persuaded to withdraw large sums of cash and post it to addresses in London. stories.title: Derbyshire grandmother praises Glan Clwyd care after north Wales holiday
stories.summary: A grandmother from Derbyshire with chronic heart failure has praised staff at Glan Clwyd Hospital after they arranged treatment that allowed her to holiday in north Wales with her grandchildren. Anita Wright, from Clay Cross in Derbyshire, has chronic heart failure after four cardiac events left her heart working at only 25 per cent capacity.

stories.title: North Wales-based equestrian safety kit firm partners with national charity to protect disabled horse riders across UK
stories.summary: Charles Owen, the world-leading manufacturer of riding safety equipment based in Wrexham, has announced a new partnership with the Riding for the Disabled Association (RDA). stories.title: Hawarden composer’s new harp concerto inspired by Connah’s Quay power station to premiere at St Asaph Cathedral
stories.summary: A new harp concerto inspired by a gas-fired power station and a Welsh music legend will have its world premiere at the festival he founded. stories.title: Theatr Clwyd to mark 50th anniversary with star-studded fundraising night
stories.summary: Alex Hassell, Sian Gibson, Rakie Ayola and Kimberly Hart-Simpson will take to the stage at Theatr Clwyd on 20 September. The Mold theatre is marking 50 years with a one-off fundraising show called Made Right Here: Theatr Clwyd at 50. Every penny from ticket sales goes towards the theatre’s work on and off the stage.
